; NES hardware registers (CPU address space).
; MMC1 serial registers: writes to ROM addresses are mapper writes.
; PPU control: NMI enable, sprite size, pattern/nametable select
; PPU mask: rendering enables and colour emphasis
; PPU status: bit 7 vblank, bit 6 sprite-0 hit; read resets PPUADDR latch
; PPU scroll (write X then Y)
; PPU VRAM address (write high then low)
; PPU VRAM data port
; sprite DMA page register
; controller 1 strobe/read
; controller 2 read / APU frame counter
; MMC1 control register (serial, 5 writes of bit 0; bit 7 resets)
; MMC1 CHR bank 0 register (serial)
; MMC1 CHR bank 1 register (serial)
; MMC1 PRG bank register (serial); value>>1 selects a 32 KiB bank here
; PRG 32 KiB bank 0 (8 KiB banks 0-3); CPU $8000-$FFFF when selected.
; ---- Code, observed: physical $00010-$00182 (CPU $8000-$8172, 8K bank 0)
; Common module ($8000-$8353). Identical copies sit at the start of 32 KiB
; banks 1 and 2; banks 3-7 hold copies at the same CPU addresses whose calls to
; bank-0-only routines are replaced by stubs. The bank-switch helpers (FarCall,
; SetChrBank, SetBanksFromValue) run from whichever copy is mapped (observed in
; traces for banks 0-6). The reset code itself is only known to run from bank 0: the reset stub
; always selects bank 0 before JMP $8000.
; Reset entry (reached from the reset stub in bank 0). Silences the PPU,
; waits two vblanks for the PPU to warm up, stops DMC/frame IRQs, clears
; RAM $0002-$07FF, selects bank 0 and performs one-time initialisation.
; stack page byte $0100 (cleared again explicitly)
; purpose unknown: no cartridge RAM is declared and no effect of the write is known
; clear both scores and their inning boxes (11 bytes each)
; same unexplained cartridge-area write as above
; DPCM request $A0 before the title (probably the title voice)
; X=9: first scene (title) through RequestScene
; Mode restart point: every mode change returns here. A ~4096-iteration
; busy delay runs first, then the screen is cleared, the next mode's PRG/CHR
; banks are selected and its init routine is entered through
; NextModeVector with a fake return address of $80D3 (pushed as $80D2).
; NMI off (DisableNmi is an entry inside EnableNmi's LDX operand)
; rendering off (entry inside EnableRendering's LDX operand)
; clear the palette to black
; clear all three nametable pairs
; RTS of the init routine resumes at ModeMainLoopEntry
; The mode init routine returns here: wait for vblank twice, upload the palette,
; scroll and PPU masks, then run the main loop.
; Main loop. Each pass stirs the random seed, runs gameplay physics
; when NmiMode is 2 (ball in play), and starts a pending DPCM voice sample.
; Loops until ModeFlags bit 7 requests a mode change and no sample is pending.
; NmiMode 2 = live play (fielding/ball physics run outside NMI)
; $F0 and above means "no sample requested"
; a hold-off timer delays the sample (decremented in NMI)
; NMI off while the sample plays (the DPCM routine busy-waits)
; FarCall target $BD00: the DPCM player in the sample's bank
; bank bits of the request choose the 32 KiB bank holding the sample
; Fill all 32 palette entries with $0F (black), then reset the PPU address.
; ---- Code, static: physical $00183-$0018C (CPU $8173-$817C, 8K bank 0)
; EnterPitchingMode (mode-init entry stored as NextModeVector by RequestPitchingMode):
; point FarCallVector at PitchingModeInit ($8396) and fall into FarCall with A=$10,
; i.e. run the pitching-view set-up in bank 1 (code by its stub layout and its use
; as a NextModeVector value).
; ---- Code, observed: physical $0018D-$002CE (CPU $817D-$82BE, 8K bank 0)
; FarCall: call the routine at FarCallVector inside another PRG bank.
; A = bank selection value (bits 4-5: 32 KiB PRG bank; also CHR bits, see
; SetBanksFromValue). The caller's bank selection is pushed, the target is
; called with a return address of $819E, and the original banks are restored.
; Works because this module exists at the same address in every bank.
; return address $819D+1 pushed for the indirect call
; FarCallReturn: FarCall pushes a return address here, so the far routine's RTS
; lands on this code; it pulls the caller's PRG selection and restores both banks.
; SetPrgBank: A bits 4-5 select the 32 KiB PRG bank (written as A>>3 to the
; MMC1 PRG register, whose bit 0 is ignored in 32 KiB mode). Remembers A in
; CurPrgSelect. MapperWriteBusy=$82 marks the serial write for NMI recovery.
; Returns with A = SavedA (meaningful only after a recovered NMI).
; SetChrBank: A bits 0-1 and bit 6 select a CHR bank (8 KiB index = value
; ((A&$40)>>4 | A&3) written x2 to MMC1 CHR0). Remembers A in CurChrSelect.
; NextRandom: RandomSeed = RandomSeed*5 + $11 (8-bit linear congruential step).
; Returns the new value in A.
; SetBanksFromValue: Y/A = combined selection value. Sets CHR0 from bits 0-1/6
; (like SetChrBank) and the PRG register from bits 4-5 and bit 7 (bit 7 -> PRG
; register bit 3, i.e. the upper 128 KiB). Used by FarCall.
; NMI recovery path for an interrupted MMC1 serial write (MapperWriteBusy was
; nonzero). The shift register is reset, control is rewritten as $02 (32 KiB
; PRG mode, vertical mirroring), PRG and CHR0 are set to 0 so the sound driver
; (RunSoundDriver) can run from bank 0, then the interrupted register is rewritten
; with its pending value. The interrupted frame's registers are restored and
; execution resumes at the tail of the interrupted switch routine (ResumeAfterChr
; at $81E1 or ResumeAfterPrg at $8272) with the interrupted status flags.
; ---- Code, observed: physical $002CF-$002D5 (CPU $82BF-$82C5, 8K bank 0)
; ---- Code, observed: physical $002D6-$00351 (CPU $82C6-$8341, 8K bank 0)
; ---- Code, static: physical $00352-$0035B (CPU $8342-$834B, 8K bank 0)
; ---- Code, observed: physical $0035C-$0038D (CPU $834C-$837D, 8K bank 0)
